section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.content: Welcome to Mostafa Yasser's platform. We are committed to protecting your personal data and your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safe-guard your information when you visit our website, purchase our Notion templates, or engage in our consulting services.

content.label: Personal Information:
content.value: We may collect your name, email address, and billing information when you subscribe to our newsletter, purchase a template, or book a consultation.

content.label: Project Data:
content.value: For consulting clients, we may receive access to your Notion workspaces or project details necessary to build your custom systems.

content.label: Usage Data:
content.value: Periodically, we collect technical data such as IP addresses, browser types, and page interaction to improve our website experience.

section3.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
content: To deliver the Notion templates and consulting services you requested.
To provide specialized support and system maintenance.
To send updates about new tools, templates, and Notion tips (you can opt-out at any time).
To process payments securely through our third-party providers.

section4.title: 4. Data Sharing & Third Parties
section4.content: We do not sell your personal data. We only share information with trusted third-party services essential for our operations, such as payment processors (Stripe/PayPal), email marketing tools, and the Notion platform itself where your systems reside.

section5.title: 5. Security & Retention
section5.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. We retain your information only as long as necessary to provide our services and comply with legal obligations.

section6.title: 6. Your Privacy Rights
section6.content: Depending on your location, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. To exercise these rights, please contact our support team.
